description: This file implements a service class 'CodeReadPlatformServiceImpl' that handles retrieval of code data from a database, including retrieving all codes, a specific code by ID, or by name. It uses Spring framework annotations and JDBC template for database operations, and it maps database results to 'CodeData' objects.

classes.name: CodeReadPlatformServiceImpl
classes.description: Service class that provides methods to retrieve code data from the database, with security and caching features.

classes.name: CodeMapper
classes.description: Private static class implementing RowMapper to convert ResultSet rows into CodeData instances.

methods.name: retrieveAllCodes
methods.description: Retrieves all code records from the database, ordered by code name, with caching and security checks.

methods.name: retrieveCode
methods.description: Retrieves a specific CodeData by its unique ID. Throws CodeNotFoundException if not found.

methods.name: retriveCode
methods.description: Retrieves a specific CodeData by its code name. Throws CodeNotFoundException if not found.
